title: This Spider Hunts Spiders Twice Its Size and Plans the Attack

scenes.text: This spider eats spiders twice its size. By lying to them.
Portia is under a centimeter long, with a brain smaller than a pinhead. It hunts web-building spiders.
It plucks their web like a trapped insect. One Portia kept it up for three days until the owner came to look.
If the owner is dangerous, Portia takes a detour out of sight for up to an hour and drops in from above.
Spitting spiders it attacks from behind. Unless they carry eggs in their jaws and can't spit. Then, head on.
Fewer than a hundred thousand neurons. And it still plans around you.

description:
A spider under a centimeter long that hunts spiders twice its size, and plans the attack.
Portia climbs onto another spider's web and plucks the silk to imitate a trapped insect; one was recorded signalling for three days until the owner came to investigate. If the prey is dangerous, Portia takes a detour out of sight for up to an hour and attacks from above. Against spitting spiders it strikes from behind, but when the spitting spider is carrying eggs in its jaws and cannot spit, Portia goes head on.
Which animal do you think is the smartest for its size?
subject: portia jumping spider
first_comment: Portia can spot and identify a spider from 30 to 40 body lengths away, with eyes only six times less sharp than yours. Which small animal has surprised you with its intelligence?
